baseline.claimScope: Receipts for identified R16 deployment only, not independent revalidation or a guarantee for later deployments.

event.timezoneRule: Local Event time; confirm actual team event. Universal start follows Team Owner residence per GO Team.

criteria.authority: 2026 local-organizer page; used as assessment lens, not verified global or Rio Verde rubric

strengths: Three mission cases and four mission segments.
Controlled experiments invoke existing deterministic domains.
Six archived Terra/MODIS records with provenance in Cerrado.
Local crew roles, temporal comparison and explicit application of an experiment.
NASA models and configurable visual spacecraft separated from physics.
limits: Bennu and telescope measurements are synthetic.
No orbital propagation, real Webb optics, live antenna scheduling or remote cooperation.
Educational effectiveness and physical mobile performance not validated.
Expedition attempts are session-local and multi-tab journal writes have documented limitations.
R17 editorial changes do not establish competition eligibility.

gaps.finding: Challenge-specific work before the stated start is documented. No organizer decision approving this project was observed.
gaps.acceptance: Preserve chronology and obtain an applicable organizer decision before claiming eligibility.

gaps.finding: Summary alignment exists; full statement and at least one actual Resources-list match remain unverified.
gaps.acceptance: Map full requirements and demonstrate a used NASA source from the official list.

gaps.finding: No team-page registration, exact event or accepted project submission inspected.
gaps.acceptance: Official team/event/challenge page and submission receipt, without unnecessary personal data.

gaps.finding: Final format, English presentation, AI/media disclosure and complete attribution not audited end to end.
gaps.acceptance: Verify current form, public links, accepted demo format and completed submission.

gaps.finding: Deterministic learning experiments are implemented; no measured student learning outcome.
gaps.acceptance: Pilot with defined audience, baseline/task/transfer explanation and reported failures; no efficacy extrapolation.

gaps.finding: Responsive viewport and browser checks exist; no physical phone/touch acceptance or measured FPS/load budget.
gaps.acceptance: Complete mission on representative laptop and phone; record browser, network, loading time, failures and 2D recovery.

gaps.finding: R17 narratives use dated NASA facts; expedition values remain synthetic and explicitly separated.
gaps.acceptance: Review all current UI and guide text, then record integrated verification and exact deployment.

gaps.finding: Multiple preserved routes exist; newcomer comprehension has not been established.
gaps.acceptance: New user finds a mission, predicts, runs, explains a failure and revises without developer instruction; record obstacles.
